It ships kernel/src/fold.rs: LedgerFold plus Folded, a derived value that ADVANCES with an append-only log rather than being invalidated by it, with ten pinned properties including FOLD equals SCAN and a chaos-rebuild harness. Ledger is unmodified, nothing enters the save, and the whole production diff against main is one new module plus one pub mod line with NO TENANT yet, so it cannot move a byte a session commits. Decisions 0236, 0237, 0238. FOUR THINGS OTHER CAMPAIGNS MAY WANT. First, kernel/src/derived.rs Validity::Ledger is NOT usable for a fold whose dependency is touched every tick: the watched DepKey commits every tick for that very subject, so the entry is stale every tick and every read is a full recompute, a cache with a structurally guaranteed 100 percent miss rate. Invalidation and accumulation are different operations. Second, MEASURED: tick cost grows with SESSION LENGTH, not just agent count. drive_at is proportional to the history it walks, elasticity 0.86 to 1.24 over four runs, and the history term is 70 to 80 percent of a tick at 144 facts per agent. Third, integrate_thirst is O(H + S times H) not O(H), from a per-segment backward scan, with the linear-to-quadratic crossover at only 146 to 189 facts per agent and 23 of 50 agents never drinking in 200 ticks so S is unbounded for them. Fourth, THE ESCAPEMENT LANDING CLEARED THE HOLD-OFF ON windows/vessel, so stages 3 to 5 are now enterable and the spec table saying otherwise is corrected.
